name: 17-submit-rule-rerun-and-override
description: The owner adds a model-checked rule at before work is submitted. The builder's submit waits on it and is refused when the check fails; the owner lets it through once and the builder's resend with the same inputs completes on the stored result. The review fails, the owner saves a new wording, and in the next round three submits with changed notes fail on the new wording while the first check keeps the first; the fourth would be a fourth run on changed inputs, so it waits at the re-run limit with no job until the owner lets it through, which completes it in place. Saved to only note a failure, the rule lets a second task's submit through at once and records the failed check when it arrives. Both reviews then pass.
covers: PRD How a transition is gated and Pending transitions: a blocking model check at task.before_submit makes the submit wait, and a failed check refuses it (blocked_by_rule, the outcome on the command, not an event).

PRD Pending transitions, L382: an override of a failed check completes nothing by itself; the requester's next request with the same inputs reuses the stored result and completes, writing no new check.
PRD Rule records and test 8, L911: saving a rule writes rule.changed and a new version; the check made before the save keeps the version it ran with.

PRD When a check cannot run, L422, and milestone 4 plan RD-45: the command that would start a fourth run on changed inputs in one round waits with its check row, no job and a rerun_limit hold with its item; the owner's override completes it in place, caused by check.overridden (RE-3).
PRD L337 and plan RC-16: a warn model check queues its job, the submit completes at once with no check step, and the failure is recorded when it arrives.
